toml:
# Xona Pulsar end to end: the public X5 signal -> a Pulsar pass -> a LEO navigation message
# -> GPS + Galileo + Pulsar fused fix and precise point positioning convergence.
#
# Every Pulsar number is public: Leclere, Marathe and Reid, "Insights into Xona Pulsar LEO
# PNT", ION GNSS+ 2025, https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19551 (X5 at 1190.51625 MHz, 10.23 Mchip/s,
# data and pilot in quadrature with a 50/50 split, received power -144.9 to -136.2 dBW;
# 258 satellites in 18 planes at about 1080 km, inclined 53 deg and polar 97 deg shells).
#
# - Signal: the `xona-x5` design from data/leo-signals/xona-pulsar.toml.
# - Pass: a maritime user in the Bay of Biscay watches a Pulsar satellite of the inclined
#   shell peak at 70 deg. The band is the link preset's X5 (flat pattern, the EIRP that
#   delivers the published minimum power at 10 deg), carrying the X5 design.
# - Navigation message: the Pulsar broadcast-ephemeris model is not public (the brief marks
#   it UNCONFIRMED), so the message is Kshana's Galileo Keplerian set with along-track,
#   cross-track and radial corrections, fitted every 300 s; 0.25 m of orbit-determination and
#   clock error is added as a representative decimetre-level figure (not a Xona figure).
# - Positioning: GPS and Galileo with the Pulsar inclined shell (192 satellites, 12 planes).
# - Precise point positioning (PPP): GPS and Galileo alone and with both Pulsar shells.
#
# MODELLED: every stage keeps its own label.
kind = "leo-pnt-chain"
name = "Xona Pulsar end to end"
seed = 9
signal_design = "xona-x5"
od_sisre_m = 0.25

[signal]
presets = ["xona-pulsar"]

[pass]
epoch = "2026-09-28T10:00:00"
duration_s = 1200.0
step_s = 5.0

[pass.user]
environment = "maritime"
lat_deg = 45.5
lon_deg = -5.0
height_m = 10.0
speed_m_s = 8.0
heading_deg = 90.0

[[pass.satellite]]
id = "Pulsar-pass"
system = "xona-pulsar"
bands = ["X5"]
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 53.0
max_elevation_deg = 70.0
tca_s = 600.0

[[pass.satellite.band]]
name = "X5"
signal = "xona-x5"

[pass.gnss]
constellation = "gps-baseline"
band = "L1"

[navmsg.message]
model = "kepler-rac"
fit_interval_s = 300.0

[navmsg.trade]
span_s = 1200.0

[fusion]
mode = "joint"
duration_s = 1800.0
step_s = 30.0

[fusion.user]
lat_deg = 45.5
lon_deg = -5.0
height_m = 10.0

[fusion.joint]
max_leo_sweep = 8

[[fusion.system]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]
sisre_m = 0.6

[[fusion.system]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]
sisre_m = 0.3
isb_ns = 12.0

[[fusion.system]]
name = "Pulsar X5"
role = "leo"
isb_ns = 40.0

[[fusion.system.shell]]
total = 192
planes = 12
phasing = 1
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 53.0

[ppp]
duration_s = 1800.0
step_s = 10.0
runs = 2

[[ppp.site]]
lat_deg = 45.5
lon_deg = -5.0

[[ppp.gnss]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[ppp.gnss]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[ppp.case]]
name = "Pulsar 258"

[[ppp.case.system]]
name = "Pulsar inclined"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[ppp.case.system.shell]]
total = 192
planes = 12
phasing = 1
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 53.0

[[ppp.case.system]]
name = "Pulsar polar"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[ppp.case.system.shell]]
total = 66
planes = 6
phasing = 1
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 97.0
summary:
Xona Pulsar end to end
  signal xona-x5 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19551), tracked pilot at 10.230 Mchip/s, C/N0 offset -2.57 dB
  pass Pulsar-pass 1080 km: tracked C/N0 peak 66.3 dB-Hz, code jitter median 0.018 m; C/N0 line 46.3 + 22.9 sin(el) dB-Hz
  message kepler-rac 300 s fit / 300 s update: representation SISRE 1.151 mm RMS (orbit 0.005 mm), with 0.250 m orbit determination: 0.250 m handed on
  fused fix: GNSS only PDOP 1.61 RMS 3D 1.49 m -> GNSS + LEO PDOP 1.14 RMS 3D 0.68 m
  PPP convergence: GNSS only 20.6 min, Pulsar 258 5.9 min
  11 values handed between stages. MODELLED.
